programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 2
programme.desc: Jeremy, Richard og James finner den beste bilen for å ta familien med på handletur med et budsjett på 5000 pund.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 3
programme.desc: Gutta prøver å finne verdens beste fireseters superbil, og Harry Potter-stjernen Rupert Grint er ukens kjendis i billigbilen.

programme.title: Top Gear: Episode 4
programme.desc: Top Gear-gutta bygger tøffe og interessante bobiler før de setter kursen mot Sørvest-England for en langhelg.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 103
programme.desc: En diaréepidemi rammer byen og Martin tar umiddelbart grep.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 104
programme.desc: Martin drar på hjemmebesøk til en skogvokter som deler sitt hjem med et gigantisk ekorn.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 105
programme.desc: En gammel venn av Joan dukker opp og vekker gamle minner.

programme.desc: Ryktene om legens "lille" problem med blod sirkulerer i landsbyen. Peter Cronk er skadet og bekymringen for hans helse bringer Martin og Louisa nærmere hverandre.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 201
programme.desc: Louisas gamle flamme, Danny Steel, kommer til Portwenn i håp om å gjenopplive romansen deres.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Troll kan lures
programme.desc: Psykotiske Kimberly fortsetter sin hevnplan ved å gi Michael skylden for å forfølge Amanda.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Det store smellet del 1 og 2
programme.desc: Brooke og Billy kunngjør at de skal gifte seg. Da Alison får høre om forlovelsen, forstår hun at Brooke har lurt henne.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Etterpågalskap
programme.desc: Morgenen etter at Melrose-komplekset eksploderer er alle på sykehuset. Alison er midlertidig blind, og Billy utsetter bryllupsreisen.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Melrose er som en konfekteske
programme.desc: Skaden etter bomben fører til merkelige boforhold. Amanda flytter inn hos Sydney, Matt hos Jo, og Alison hos Jane.

programme.title: The Vows We Keep
programme.desc: En eventplanlegger finner kjærligheten mens hun jobber med å arrangere det siste bryllupet på en historisk taverna.

programme.title: Sweet Carolina
programme.desc: Josie vender tilbake til den lille hjembyen sin da hun uventet blir verge for niesen og nevøen sin. Der møter hun Cooper, kjæresten fra high school.

programme.title: The Ice Road
programme.desc: Etter at en fjerntliggende diamantgruve kollapser i Nord-Canada tar Mike oppdraget med å lede redningsoperasjonen, og må trosse de brutale naturkreftene i Canadas villmark.

programme.title: Wildfire: Friendship/Passion
programme.desc: The pressure is on Junior to decide whether or not to go through with his wedding to Laura after he and Kris share a moment of passion.

programme.title: Wildfire: Commitment Issues
programme.desc: When it appears that Flame is ready for his first race, Kris decides to fight to get her jockey's license reinstated.

programme.title: Wildfire: Life's Too Short
programme.desc: Kris hopes that Flame's success in the DuPont Stakes might help Jean change her mind about Raintree's future, but Kris isn't so sure about what part---if any---she'll play in it.

programme.title: Wildfire: Vows
programme.desc: Kris and Junior hastily decide to get married, but they're forced to postpone their plans when Jean is injured by one of the horses rescued by Matt.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Comeback
programme.desc: With Jean still out of commission, Kris and Matt do their best to run the dude ranch at Raintree while also preparing for the next race, which features Dani's new horse in the field

programme.title: Candy Cane Candidate
programme.desc: En kvinne vender tilbake til hjembyen til jul etter en mislykket kampanje og møter sin gamle rival.

programme.title: A Chestnut Family Christmas
programme.desc: En privat kokk må finne på noe for å imponere den ambisiøse familien hennes før de kommer for å tilbringe jul med henne.

programme.title: The Jingle Bell Jubilee
programme.desc: En ordfører får hjelp av en barndomsvenn til å arrangere byens juleinnsamling, mens hun setter i gang med å spleise ham med sin nære venninne.

programme.title: The Female Brain
programme.desc: Den strenge nevroforskeren Julias dypdykk i hvordan den kvinnelige og den mannlige hjernen jobber. Men Julias standhaftige oppfatninger blir utfordret når en kjekk ny deltaker melder seg til prosjektet hennes.

programme.title: The Giant Mechanical Man
programme.desc: To ensomme sjeler finner kjærlighet og en forbindelse midt i storbyens kaos. En hjertevarm fortelling om kunst, skjeve eksistenser og humor.

programme.title: Charming the Hearts of Men
programme.desc: Et romantisk drama under det politisk ladede tidlige 60-tallet, der en sofistikert kvinne vender tilbake til hjembyen i sør og oppdager at hennes muligheter er begrenset og diskriminering florerer.

programme.title: Scorpion: Crazy Train
programme.desc: Teamet må stoppe en sabotert løpsk T-banetog med Paige og Ralph om bord. Toby har sin første boksekamp i sitt forsøk på å imponere Happy.

programme.title: Scorpion: Area 51
programme.desc: For å hjelpe til med å finansiere Walters forskning for å redde søsterens liv, tar Team Scorpion en lukrativ jobb for CIA for å finne et topphemmelig fly i det mystiske Area 51.

programme.title: Scorpion: US vs. UN vs. UK
programme.desc: Team Scorpion blir utpresset til å bryte seg inn i FN for å hjelpe til med attentatet på en truende våpenhandler. Dessuten gjør Sylvester et dristig trekk for å beskytte Megans ønsker.

programme.title: Scorpion: Arrivals and Departures
programme.desc: Når teamet og Walters foreldre besøker Megan på sykehuset mens helsen hennes blir dårligere, blir de satt i karantene etter at et dødelig sopputbrudd truer med å infisere alle.

programme.title: Scorpion: The Old College Try
programme.desc: Team Scorpion går undercover på et universitet for å finne en hacker som infiltrerer Federal Reserve og truer med å kollapse verdensøkonomien.

programme.title: Scorpion: Dam Breakthrough
programme.desc: På julaften må Team Scorpion forhindre en katastrofe når styrtregn skaper en stor sprekk i en demning, som truer med å utslette en hel by i dens kjølvann.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: Don and his team hunt down a 30-year-old teacher and her 17-year- old boyfriend who are on a crime spree from Indiana to Los Angeles, on part one of a two-part third season premiere.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: Desperate to rescue their fellow agent, Don and his team close in on finding Megan, who is being held hostage by a disturbed teacher (Kim Dickens) on a vicious crime spree, on part two of the two-part season premiere.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: Don and his team must determine if a shooting on the freeway was a random act of violence or the work of a serial killer preying on the citizens of Los Angeles.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: When a painting worth millions of dollars is stolen from a museum just before it is to go on tour, Don and his team must track down the thief, believing it is part of an insurance scam.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: When an interpreter working for the Chinese consulate is killed in an apparent hit and run accident, Don and his team uncover an unlikely connection to the Department of Justice.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: When Don and his team investigate a murder at a horse track, they stumble onto more than just a plot of betting on fixed races. Aya Sumika ("The O.C.") begins her recurring role as agent Liz Warner, Don's former trainee.

programme.title: Nemesis 2 - Nebula
programme.desc: En skrekkslagen mor bringer sin lille datter, Alex, tilbake til vår tid for å unnslippe robotene som hersker i hennes tidsalder. Alex vokser opp hos en krigersk afrikansk stamme. 19 år senere oppsporer tobetene Alex for å utslette henne.

programme.title: The Curse of the Jade Scorpion
programme.desc: C.W. Biggs er forsikringsetterforsker i 1940-tallets New York. I hans egne øyne er han byens beste, ikke minst fordi han påstår å kunne knekke enhver forsikringssvindel ved å gå inn i tankene til svindleren.

programme.title: Blue Chips
programme.desc: Pete Bell, en college-baskettrener, er under mye press. Laget hans vinner ikke. Fremtidens stjerner blir betalt av andre lag. Denne praksisen er forbudt i college-spillet, men Pete er desperat og har press fra alle sider.

programme.title: Cheers: The Bar Stoolie
programme.desc: Cliff får vite at farens hans lever et hemmelig liv.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: North Jutland

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery NO: Trysil

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sphere of Influence
programme.desc: When an 11-year-old girl disappears from a remote Alaska town, investigators wonder if she has been attacked by a bear or become lost in the dense woods. Eventually, they realize that neither assumption is true.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Nailed
programme.desc: Just weeks before a witness is to testify against the man accused of sexually assaulting her, she is murdered in the front yard of her own home. Investigators immediately suspect her attacker, but they don't have enough evidence to prove his guilt.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sign of the Zodiac
programme.desc: For six years, a serial killer prowled the streets of New York City. He wrote letters to police and The New York Post, indicating he would kill twelve people — one for each astrological sign.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Letter Perfect
programme.desc: A healthy young man dies mysteriously in his sleep and toxicology tests reveal a lethal dose of lidocaine in his blood. Investigators find a suicide note and presume he killed himself until a forensic linguist examines the note.

programme.title: Forensic Files: True Lies
programme.desc: In the summer of 1986, Kathleen Lipscomb's body was found on a deserted road outside of San Antonio. Months and years passed, but the crime was never solved. Finally, a private investigator discovered Kathleen's diary.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bed of Deceit
programme.desc: A retired police officer is found dead with a single gunshot wound to the head. His wife says the motive was robbery, but later tells police he committed suicide.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smoke in your Eyes
programme.desc: A suspicious fire sweeps through an apartment, killing two young women. The cause of the fire and the identity of the victims are unclear, but a closer look at the scene reveals something hidden in the ashes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Flower Power
programme.desc: Two different men called police to report the same murder. Apparently, neither one knew that the other had called. The investigation uncovered even more unusual circumstances.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Past Lives
programme.desc: The body of a wealthy American businessman was found in his rental car. Teeth and bone fragments were the only remains. When the victim's wife files an insurance claim for $7 million, investigators seek the help of a renowned forensic anthropologist.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Over and Out
programme.desc: When a pipe bomb rips through a rural home, police have no idea who is responsible. A 9-volt battery and the remnants of a mailing label ead investigators to the man who made the bomb.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Death by a Salesman
programme.desc: No one in a quiet residential community saw anything unusual the day one of their neighbors was brutally attacked and murdered. Fingerprints found at the crime scene and surveillance video helped investigators to apprehend the presumed killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Held For Ransom
programme.desc: Wealth has its rewards, but it also brings its dangers. Kidnapping is one of them. No ordeal is more horrifying for a family than to have a child taken.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Millionaire Murder
programme.desc: A businessman went to Florida to make one last deal before he retired-he never returned home to his millions. Authorities examined who was closest to him and who stood to gain from his disappearance. But this time conventional rules didn't apply.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Family Torn
programme.desc: The parents of 11 yr. old Brittany Martinez knew their daughter was no runaway. Something had happened to her, something terrible. When they failed to find Brittany in their quiet Illinois neighborhood, they called the police.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Model Killer
programme.desc: It's a model's job to rivet the public's attention. But in 1984, some aspiring models began attracting publicity in a terrible new way.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Loved To Death
programme.desc: A victim usually never foresees danger when the perpetrator turns out to be a friend or a lover. Science and microscopic evidence can unmask these killers and find justice for those who are Loved To Death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Betrayed
programme.desc: Sometimes when a death seems to be accidental or the result of a tragic accident, it is up to forensic scientists to reveal the deception lying just below the surface.

programme.title: The New Detectives: False Witness
programme.desc: When a murder is committed and deceit clouds the evidence, investigators turn to science and technology to uncover the truth and expose a murderous lie and capture the killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Face Of Tragedy
programme.desc: Forensic Sculpting: Forensic sculptors retrieve people from oblivion. Using clay and an intricate knowledge of anatomy, forensic arts place a face on an unidentified skull, recreating the victim's likeness, which often leads to his name.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner's Casebook
programme.desc: A good coroner provides what's necessary to solve a crime. A bad one can spoil an otherwise rock-solid case. Cyril Wecht and Henry Lee, two of the country's most respected coroners, share their cases and insights into crime solving.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Victim Zero
programme.desc: A brawl erupts at a local bar ends with the shooting death of a army solider. To unravel the murder, Lt. Joe Kenda most infiltrate a revered military institution, and expose a dangerous vendetta.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: A Killer Always Rings Twice
programme.desc: When 22 year-old Micki Filmore is found raped and murder in her apartment, detective Kenda focuses his investigation on her activities the previous night.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: I Now Pronounce You Dead
programme.desc: Mother of 3 Dianne Hood is shot to death by a masked gunman on her way home from a Lupus support meeting. Joe Kenda uncovers a sordid web of lust and greed, revealing a killer no one ever expected.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Death Rains Down
programme.desc: Restaurant worker Sharon Coleman is murdered in a hail of large caliber gunfire. Kenda must break through a web of lies to hunt down one of the most dangerous criminal masterminds he’s ever faced.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Fractured Glass
programme.desc: When affable ladies’ man Michael Tittemore is gunned down in the dead of night, Kenda first sets his sights on the roommates who were present during the murder.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Interface
programme.desc: The interface between Earth and space is the Ionosphere, a region of rarified gas and charged particles. It is very important for radio communications, radar, satellite signals and global positioning. Yet we know so little about it.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Planted Evidence
programme.desc: One morning in a deserted area outside of Phoenix, a motorcyclist discovers the body of a young woman. She had been beaten, bound, strangled and possibly raped. Nearby plants tell investigators more about the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Wilson Murder
programme.desc: On the night of May 22, 1992, Betty Wilson returned home after a meeting and discovered her husband lying in a pool of blood. Jack Wilson had obviously been murdered — but how?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insect Clues

programme.title: iCarly: Verden er rystet del 2
programme.desc: Jimmy Fallon inviterer iCarly-gjengen til å opptre live i programmet sitt i New York, men en stor klesmiss fra Gibby betyr store problemer for nettshowets fremtid.

programme.title: iCarly: Spencers venner
programme.desc: iCarly-gjengen vil finne venner til Spencer på hans egen alder. De finner noen gode muligheter, men vil vennskapet blomstre?

programme.title: iCarly: Den stjålne laptoppen
programme.desc: Når Sams laptop blir stjålet, prøver iCarly-gjengen å hjelpe henne med å oppspore tyven. Imens får Spencer vite at han ikke får komme inn i sin yndlingsspillehall hvis han ikke er i følge med et barn. Hellet snur når Guppy trenger barnevakt.

programme.title: iCarly: Farvel del 2
programme.desc: Carly er på vei til å akseptere at hun ikke kan gå på det årlige ballet, da faren hennes dukker opp og går sammen med henne. Kvelden tar en uventet vending når faren hennes stiller et livsavgjørende spørsmål.

programme.title: iCarly: Vårt eget webshow
programme.desc: Når Miss Briggs avviser alle yndlingsdeltagerne deres fra uttakene til talenshowet, bestemmer Carly og Sam seg for å lage sitt eget talentshow for klassekameratene gjennom iCarly på nettet.

programme.title: iCarly: Herr Nesten Perfekt
programme.desc: Carly er keen på en gutt på skolen som heter Jake. Han er råkul og kjekk, og fordi hun liker ham, inviterer hun Jake til å spille gitar og synge på sitt nye webshow. Men hun oppdager forsent at Jake synger helt forferdelig.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg vil ha flere seere
programme.desc: Carly og Sam konkurrerer med Freddie og Spencer om å finne den beste planen for hvordan å få flere ungdommer til å se på iCarlys websendinger. Når alle planene deres slår helt feil, blir alt helt sprøtt.

programme.title: iCarly: En pågående kritiker
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie vil at web-showet deres skal bli anmeldt av 'Nevelocity', en populær webside for slike anmeldelser. Carly drar for å møte Nevel, og det viser seg at han er en irriterende gutt som vil date henne.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg vil bli hos Spencer
programme.desc: Bestefaren til Carly og Spencer kommer på overraskelsesvisitt. Han tror at Spencer er for uansvarlig til å passe på Carly. Carly og vennene hennes må bevise overfor bestefaren at Spencer er i stand til det.

programme.title: iCarly: Rekordforsøket
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie prøver å slå verdensrekorden for den lengste sammenhengende nettvideovisningen. For å klare det, må iCarly gå i over 24 timer i ett kjør.

programme.title: iCarly: En date med Freddie
programme.desc: Valerie er iCarly-fan og ber Freddie på date. Daten går så bra at Freddie begynner å filme Valeries eget webshow. Men når hennes webshow kommer i veien for iCarly, får Freddie problemer.
